object_flow.proven: ECX receives caller EDI immediately before the producer call. Denote this pointer Q; allocation, type and lifetime are not inferred.
Producer saves caller EDI and assigns EDI=entry ECX=Q.
DWORD [EDI+0x68] is written from EAX. V8 calls this the T threshold producer.
object_flow.conditional: Attribution to Q after intervening calls requires EDI preservation by those callees; their bodies are not proved here. No new complete producer reconstruction.

object_flow.conditional: Execution returns through this epilogue with balanced call/stack discipline and intact saved slot; exceptional and nonreturning paths are not covered.

Candidate assigns ESI=entry ECX before its first call, establishing ESI=Q at this point.
object_flow.conditional: At later ESI-relative instructions, preservation across calls remains an obligation, not a proved custom ABI.
